ashlr.instructions: Prefer Ashlr tools when they reduce context: use ashlr__read for large files, ashlr__grep for search, ashlr__tree for directory maps, ashlr__bash for verbose shell output, ashlr__savings for token/cost accounting, and ashlr__genome_* tools for project memory. Pass cwd explicitly or set ASHLR_ALLOW_PROJECT_PATHS for workspaces outside the MCP launch cwd.
